description: Master navigation map. Load SKILL.md + this file to orient, then open ONLY the one note the task needs.

notes.title: PRD Authoring Playbook
notes.summary: Read the spec, write objectives + scope-in, reproduce the out-of-scope wall, map EVERY success scenario to a testable gate copied 1:1 + its build phase, list the launch-blockers, write the build plan, run the scope pass, then create the work items in order (epic -> PRD -> stories) and hand off LAST.
notes.load_when: Authoring or updating the PRD from the spec or a user request.

notes.title: docs/ Roadmap Playbook
notes.summary: Own the roadmap as committed markdown: epic(s) per milestone, user stories decomposed across the COMPLETE flow graph (dependency chain + full entity lifecycle x every access state) and linked to their epic, the PRD, tasks, milestones, then regenerate + commit the roadmap mirror.
notes.load_when: Creating or refreshing the roadmap and its machine-readable mirror.

notes.title: Brainstorm / Idea-Exploration Playbook
notes.summary: Pre-PRD exploration WITH the user: load the brainstorming skill, ground in the project config + spec, ask ONE question at a time, propose 2-3 approaches with a recommendation, present a design, get approval. Read/think-only, scope wall still applies.
notes.load_when: Shaping an idea or exploring options before any PRD exists.

notes.title: Final Acceptance Sign-Off Playbook
notes.summary: The terminal gate: score EVERY success scenario PASS/FAIL with evidence, check every launch-blocker, verify 100% end-to-end breadth (every story = a dedicated passing test), compile blockers, emit ONE binary verdict, organize the docs/ folder (stale statuses, follow-ups), refresh + commit the roadmap mirror.
notes.load_when: The build is delivered and needs the final pass/fail sign-off.

notes.title: On-Demand Standup Playbook
notes.summary: Evidence-based Done/Last, Next/Plan, Blockers. Roadmap mirror FIRST, live scan only when stale; test/CI numbers recency-reconciled most-recent-wins with timestamp/environment/commit. Read-only.

notes.title: Scope Guard Playbook
notes.summary: The continuous 'is X in scope?' check that runs INSIDE every mode: restate the request, check the out-of-scope list, check the declared business model, check the in-scope + launch-blocking sections, emit '<Yes|No> - <spec section>.' and name the spec edit that would reverse a No.
notes.load_when: Any request, feature idea, or proposal needs a scope ruling.

notes.title: The Roadmap Mirror — docs/roadmap.json (PM-owned)
notes.summary: The machine-readable mirror of the docs/ roadmap: what it holds (every work item + status, milestones past/current/next, summary counts), the concrete schema, the one refresh moment (the acceptance gate), and the staleness rule.
notes.load_when: Reading or rebuilding the roadmap mirror, or judging whether the snapshot is stale.

notes.title: Standup — parts, data sources, and recency reconciliation
notes.summary: The three standup parts and what each pulls from, the priority-ordered data sources (mirror first, live scan last), and the most-recent-wins reconciliation for test/CI numbers by timestamp/environment/commit.
notes.load_when: Producing a standup, or deciding which test/CI status is current.
